visualIdea: One physical red telephone cable carries a client signal through a complete business system.

type.behavior: Oversized editorial uppercase, tight display tracking, short labels, exact code-native Ukrainian text.

imageLanguage: Approved glossy red rotary telephone photography
One signal-red line used as a causal object, never decoration

motionLanguage.camera: Restrained continuous lateral travel with a shallow 5 percent push-in; no handheld motion.
motionLanguage.timing: Fast tactile arrivals, readable holds, stable final 24-frame lockup.

audioLanguage: Sparse analog telephone and relay punctuation over a low studio hum; no voice-over and no music bed.
mustPreserve: Use the original logo JPEG only; crop and scale its complete presentation without redrawing or recoloring it.
Exactly one phone, one cable and one signal packet.
The cable never branches and never gains a parallel translucent shadow line.
The phone remains a still approved photograph; motion comes from camera, masks and an isolated dial crop.
